title: ComiTrans
summary: Windows comic translation desktop application combining ONNX local detection/OCR/cleanup, configurable translation APIs, region editing and PDF/page export.
documentation_observations: README describes OCR/detection/inpainting locally using ONNX, and AI API translation with text-only or full-page-image options.
README describes page-level resume and manual typesetting corrections in the GUI.
limitations: Official documentation reviewed, but not installed or benchmarked by NaughtyBoddy. Low-refusal behavior, actual quality, privacy, performance and current release availability are not proven.
